messages.subject: Bifactor Model, Converging
parts:
# A Simulate data reflecting a bifactor Model (3 factors; 3 items per factor)
# A1. Set up the loading matrix
myfload <- matrix(c(round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), rep(0, 6),
                    rep(0,3), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), rep(0,3),
                    rep(0,6), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2), round(rnorm(1, 0.8, .1),2)),
                  ncol = 3)

# A2. Set up the correlation matrix for the three factors
a_a <- 1
a_b <- round(rnorm(1, +.1, .05),2);
a_c <- round(rnorm(1, -.3, .05),2)
b_b <-1
b_c <- round(rnorm(1, +.1, .05),2)
c_c <-1
myphi <- matrix(c( a_a, a_b, a_c,
                 a_b, b_b, b_c,
                 a_c, b_c, c_c), ncol=3)

# A3. Generate data with the above structure
myout <- simFA(Loadings =
                  list(FacPattern = myfload),
                Phi =
                  list(PhiType = "user",
                       UserPhi = myphi),
                Bifactor =
                  list(Bifactor = TRUE,
                       F1FactorRange = c(.3, 4),
                       F1FactorDist = "fixed"),
                FactorScores =
                  list(FS = TRUE,
                       Population = TRUE,
                       NFacScores = 300))

# A4. Get the data from the simulation
data1    <- data.frame(myout$Scores$Observed)

# A5. Get the factor scores from the simulation
Fscores1 <- data.frame(myout$Scores$FactorScores)

# A6. Add id numbers to merge the two datasets
data1$id <- 1:nrow(data1); Fscores1$id <- 1:nrow(Fscores1);

# A7. Merge the two dataset
df <- merge(data1, Fscores1, by.x="id")

# B. Lavaan Section
# B1. Lavaan perfectly replicates the bifactor model
library(lavaan)
m1 <- '
factor1 =~ X1 + X2 + X3
factor2 =~ X4 + X5 + X6
factor3 =~ X7 + X8 + X9
factorH =~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6 + X7 + X8 + X9
'
fit_m1 <- sem(m1, estimator="MLM",orthogonal=T, data=df)
summary(fit_m1, fit.measures=T, standardized=T)

# B2. Now assume that I create a dependent variable, called DV,  within the dataset
df$DV <- (.20*df$G)+(.20*df$F1) +(.00*df$F2)+(-.20*df$F3)+ rnorm(nrow(df), 0, 3)

# B3.  A Regression Model predicts the dependent variable as follows
m2a <- lm(DV ~ G + F1 + F2 + F3, data=df); summary(m2a)

# B4. The same model, through lavaan, fails to converge
m2b <- '
factor1 =~ X1 + X2 + X3
factor2 =~ X4 + X5 + X6
factor3 =~ X7 + X8 + X9
factorH =~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6 + X7 + X8 + X9
DV ~ factorH + factor1 + factor2 + factor3
'
fit_m2b <- sem(m2b, estimator="MLM",orthogonal=T, data=df)
summary(fit_m2b, fit.measures=T, standardized=T)

So, what am I missing here? Is there a way to get the model to converge?
I thank you for your consideration
Thanasis
